# Generated by `deno task ignore:audit:update` — do NOT hand-edit.
#
# Every line is a KNOWN BUG at an AST position (`{parent}.{field}`), one line per graded
# check an injected `// prettier-ignore` fails there:
#
#   UNHONORED       — an own-line directive is NOT honored: the formatter reformats the
#                     ignored node instead of emitting it verbatim (the drop-in contract
#                     violation).
#   TRAILING_FROZEN — a directive TRAILING the preceding line (content before it on its
#                     line) freezes the node anyway, violating the decided inert-placement
#                     floor.
#   OVERFROZEN      — MORE than the ignored node is frozen: a doubled structural space
#                     outside the node survives the format (over-freezing otherwise reads
#                     as "honored").
#   UNSTABLE        — the injection's output is not a format fixed point: pass 2 changes
#                     it (the freeze-on-pass-1 / inert-on-pass-2 relocation class).
#
# The gate fails on a line that is NOT here (a newly-discovered finding), on a line here
# that no longer fires (a stale entry — delete it when you fix the position), and on any
# PANIC (never listed; that invariant is absolute).
#
# Counts are deliberately not pinned: they churn with every ordinary fixture PR. Positions
# ARE pinned (this is a ratchet over a live bug family, born red).
#
# Format: KIND<TAB>POSITION
# shapes: 90
